patch_description: This crossover combines the strongest elements of the provided scripts: (1) a zero-lag Kalman-style adaptive smoothing core that estimates both level and slope (so trend direction is preserved with minimal phase delay), (2) an SNR-adaptive gain scheduler that tightens smoothing in noisy regimes and relaxes it when the signal is clean (preserving dynamics), (3) a hysteresis-based trend/reversal detector with slope-change penalty to suppress spurious directional flips, and (4) a short polynomial lookahead projection used only as a gating signal (not output), which improves reversal decisions without introducing actual phase lag. The implementation is fully vectorized/online (O(1) per sample), minimizing latency while jointly optimizing the four objectives: slope-change minimization, lag error, tracking accuracy, and false-reversal penalty.
